title: Salmon Broth Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with salmon and a rich broth.
instructions: Heat the kissed in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon and cook until browned on both sides, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the salmon from the pan and set aside.
Add the broth to the pan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the cooked salmon back into the pan and simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes.
